Section 1: INI-SS April 2026 Recall (Marrow SS) [MCQs 1-42]
MCQ 1 Trabectedin Efficacy in Translocation-Associated Soft Tissue Sarcomas
●​ Topic Discussion: Trabectedin ET743 is a marine alkaloid. It binds the minor groove of DNA.
○​ Clinical Approvals: approved in leiomyosarcoma and liposarcoma.
Synovial Sarcoma t(X;18)(p11;q11) SS18-SSX1 / SSX2
●​ Question Stem: Trabectedin shows dramatically high efficacy against sarcomas harboring
which of the following molecular alterations?
●​ Options:
○​ A. NAB2STAT6 fusion
○​ B. SS18-SSX [t(X;18)] translocation
○​ C. MDM2 amplification
○​ D. EWSR1-FLI1 fusion
●​ Correct Answer: Option B (SS18-SSX [t(X;18)] translocation in Synovial Sarcoma)
●​ Why Correct: Trabectedin displaces oncogenic fusion proteins in translocation sarcomas.
●​ Why Other Options Are Wrong:
○​ Option A (NAB2-STAT6): Pathognomonic of Solitary Fibrous Tumor SFT,
managed with surgery or TKIs.
○​ Option C (MDM2 amplification): Characteristic of well-differentiated liposarcoma.
○​ Option D (EWSR1-FLI1): Seen in Ewing sarcoma — treated with VDC/IE.
MCQ 43 (April 2023 – MCQ 1): Acute Myeloid Leukemia Subtype Cured Without
Conventional Cytotoxic Chemotherapy
●​ Topic Discussion: APML is cured with ATRA plus arsenic trioxide.
●​ Question Stem: Which subtype of AML with WBC 10 or  5 is CD15 and cured using differentiating agents alone?
●​ Options:
○​ A. Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia
○​ B. AML with t(8;21)
○​ C. AML with inv(16)
○​ D. Acute Monoblastic Leukemia
●​ Correct Answer: Option A (Acute Promyelocytic Leukemia)
●​ Why Correct: Low-risk APML is cured with ATRA plus ATO.
●​ Why Other Options Are Wrong:
○​ Options B, C, and D: Non-M3 AML needs cytotoxic induction.
MCQ 44: Broken one with no options
●​ Question Stem: A stem with nothing else?
●​ Correct Answer: Option A
